text:
ara: quick alert from nova-x onboarding (q8 quant). Noticeable BLEU dip on zh->en and ja->en pairs and weird punctuation mirroring for mixed-rtl snippets. Greedy generation looks fine; sampling shows punctuation flips and stray spaces inside CJK grapheme clusters. anyone seen this with q8?
ben: can you paste a tiny repro + run args?
ara: run on dedicated-staging, quant=q8, sampler=top-p=0.95,temp=0.9. short stats and one example below.
```
# stats (n=100 samples)
locale mean_entropy kl_vs_float token_split_rate
en     3.0         0.0        0.01
zh     4.8         1.2        0.07
ja     4.6         1.1        0.06
ar     4.2         0.9        0.05
# example src zh: "\u8bf7\u5728\u4e0b\u9762\u63d0\u7a0b\u4e2d\u8f93\u5165\u60a8\u7684\u540d\u79f0\u3002"
sample: "\u8bf7\u5728 \u4e0b\u9762\u63d0\u7a0b\u4e2d \u8f93\u5165\u60a8\u7684 \u540d\u79f0\u3002"
mixed-rtl src ar+en: "\u0627\u0644\u0639\u0646\u0648\u0627\u0646 (username) \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062f\u062e\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u062e\u0627\u0635\u0629)"
sample: "\u0627\u0644\u0639\u0646\u0648\u0627\u0646 )username( \u0627\u0644\u0645\u062f\u062e\u0644 \u0627\u0644\u062e\u0627\u0635\u0629("
```
maya: looks like two classes of issues: 1) token split insertion (spaces) inside CJK clusters, 2) parenthesis mirroring when LTR tokens embedded in RTL sentences. Both appear only under stochastic sampling on q8.
devops-bot: note: recent runtime change "fast-softmax-q8" deployed 4 days ago (deploy/2026-03-20).
ben: hypothesis: quant rounding reduces margin between neighboring CJK subtokens and fused softmax in q8 runtime changes tie-breaking under stochastic sampling. Greedy OK because top-1 unaffected.
ara: i tried forcing utf-normalize detok and the split rate reduced to 0.03 but not baseline. also tried lowering temp to 0.6 -> entropy drops ~0.9 and token_split_rate drops ~40% but still above float baseline.
maya: can you run a short kernel toggle: q8-runtime with float-weights (if available) and float-runtime with q8-weights to isolate weight vs kernel arithmetic? also capture softmax inputs and ranks for the span.
ben: i'll queue 2x2 matrix now. also planning a 6-point bisect over commits touching softmax/fused kernels last week.
eval-bot: started run ci-7034 (nova-x q8 sampling-matrix). link: https://ci.internal/runs/ci-7034 :rocket:
ara: created ticket ML-1420 with examples and assigned @ben to bisect, @maya to curate prompt set, and @infra to check fast-softmax rollout. will follow up in ~3h.
maya: good short-term mitigation suggestion: add a gating rule in onboarding: if token_split_rate delta > 0.04 for CJK when sampling with default hyperparams, mark onboarding as blocked for q8. also add a sampling entropy smoke check.
ben: agreed. if bisect points to fast-softmax, we'll revert and run a perf vs quality tradeoff, and consider fallback to unfused softmax for q8 until we can fix numerical stability.
ara: thanks all, uploading logs and logits diffs to the ticket. :thumbsup:
